name: flag
assumes: one --name token after the tool's name, where name is the schema argument's exact snake_case name (or not, for kind=unknown)
--help or -h anywhere means tool help instead (see exit), and --cache alone is the command line's own flag
word = true or false; number = text a person types as a number (e.g. 3, -1, 2.5); text = anything else; dash = the next token starts with '-'
a value the flag takes is then checked by the tool's schema, which may still refuse it (a usage error, see exit)
